question: Do the captured TacticalWeaponMovement feature and simulation/presentation expressions expose weapon-dependent aiming or firing-readiness behavior that can support a useful movement/handling comparison?

notes: All three scoped release roots decoded with the pinned Head 4892017 descriptor.
Six direct one-hop assets were selected; the selected-chain check passed all 19 import assertions.
The six-target cap is exhausted. No additional target was followed.

control.description: Known-answer m433 ADS recoil amount control: GS_HK433 raw f32 at offset 1084; descriptor path /Field_c5d1c8fe/Field_6b84de87/Field_22810b21 and L127 provenance child GS_HK433.Recoil.Zoomed.RecoilAmount.

roots.finding: The feature imports the exact scoped SimEx and PresEx file/object GUIDs.
SimEx declares named mounted/aim state channels and imports movement settings and source channels. Its compiled operations are not semantically decoded.
PresEx declares mounted/aim presentation channels and directly imports FilterAngle(up), ClearMountPathFromHead, OptionMountPreset, and OptionMountType. The expression graph is not executed.

inference: The decoded labels and direct imports establish a source-named mounted/tactical context. They do not establish expression evaluation or runtime activation.
A GetWeaponBasicStateNode label alone does not prove a weapon-specific comparison or firing-readiness condition.
The typed settings can be considered as operator-reviewed context alongside L108 mounted recoil evidence, but L131 does not define a comparison suitable for an Analyzer site proposal.
unresolved: No validated reader establishes compiled expression operations, evaluation order, or the meaning of GetWeaponBasicStateNode in this graph.
The direct imports and labels do not establish a weapon-dependent aim or firing-readiness comparison, a firing restriction, or a link to a specific site weapon.
The generic TWM tuple field roles (including presumed value/default/bounds roles) are unassigned. Delay units and composition are unresolved; MountBreakoutDelay remains a typed nested struct payload.
Option assets list choices, but no selected preset, mount type, or breakout choice is established.
Source serialization does not establish runtime activation, composition, or native behavior.
Direct imports OptionPeekType, DQD_VehicleVelocity, and KillSwitches_CH1 were not followed; the six-target cap was reached. Their omission is not a negative finding.
Other fire/weapon-named channels present in the broad channel collection were not established as direct imports by these scoped roots.
No 63-weapon GS/WB crosswalk scan or site edits were performed.
siteImpact: No site data or code change is justified. The source adds named mounted/tactical context alongside the separate L108 GRM_MountedPlus source modifiers, but does not identify a source-backed comparison to add to Analyzer standing/moving or sprint-recovery inputs. No capture requested.

orchestratorReview.scope: Three roots plus six direct targets;15 retained scalar/bool operands.
orchestratorReview.siteEncodingNotes: The site sprint recovery is a millisecond ladder; ADS move tiers are dimensionless. TWM named settings have unassigned units/roles and no proven link to these inputs. L108 recoil modifiers remain a separate conditional source binding.
orchestratorReview.classification: Source finding; no supported weapon-dependent aim/firing-readiness comparison or enhancement proposal.

leads.title: Tactical weapon movement and handling context
leads.summary: The three 1.4.3.0 TacticalWeaponMovement roots expose named mounted/aim channels and exact imports to typed mount settings, but no weapon-dependent aiming/firing-readiness comparison is established.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen if exact-build expression semantics or a runtime/consumer trace binds these settings and channels to a weapon-state, aiming, or firing-readiness comparison.
